name: relay
tagline_zh: 别让Agent干等轮询了。消息一到立刻唤醒，频道、私聊、指令全通。像给AI团队装了内部对讲机，协作不再卡壳。
tagline_en: Stop polling. Wake on message, chat in channels or DMs, trigger actions. Give your agents a walkie-talkie for.
desc_en: Real time communication for agents. Wake on message, channels, DMs and actions. Useful for orchestrating agents.
why_zh: 同类靠定时拉取，它靠事件推送。消息即唤醒，零延迟，还自带频道和私信，编排Agent像拉群一样简单。
why_en: Event-driven wake-up beats polling. Built-in channels and DMs turn agent orchestration into instant group chat.
